one_line: Nvidia probes CEO, AI firms raise $300B, major AI deals close, regulators increase oversight.

themes.title: Nvidia probes CEO over spy affair
themes.text: Nvidia's board launched an independent investigation after CEO Jensen Huang admitted an affair with a suspected Chinese spy, stating there is no evidence of national security breaches.

stories.headline: Nvidia board launches investigation after CEO Jensen Huang admits affair
Nvidia board launches probe into CEO Jensen Huang over alleged spy plot
Nvidia board investigates CEO Jensen Huang over affair with alleged Chinese spy

themes.title: AI firms raise $300B in stock
themes.text: AI companies sold or priced over $300 billion of stock in 2026, with an additional $100 billion planned, while a report notes IT firms that can monetize AI without heavy capital spend may attract investors.

stories.headline: AI companies sell $300B+ in stock in 2026 amid market absorption questions
IT firms with lower capital requirements may gain as investors shift focus to AI monetisation: Report

themes.title: Major AI product deals announced
themes.text: Ada and Dialpad agreed to merge their AI customer‑service platforms in an all‑share deal valuing Ada at about C$600 million; Disney partnered with Adobe to develop proprietary generative‑AI models for its content pipeline; Apple’s CEO urged an accelerated AI roadmap beyond incremental Siri updates.

stories.headline: Ada and Dialpad merge to combine AI customer service software
Disney and Adobe partner to build proprietary generative AI models
Apple CEO John Ternus pushes for accelerated AI strategy and agentic Siri

themes.title: Governments tighten AI oversight
themes.text: The EU’s Digital Fairness Act proposal would require disabling addictive features and regulate AI relationship simulators; U.S. AI safety center officials were asked to report informally to a White House office; former President Trump claimed the DOJ threatened a top AI executive with arrest over alleged misconduct.

stories.headline:
EU's proposed Digital Fairness Act targets addictive features and AI
relationships
US AI safety center officials asked to informally report to White House
Trump says DOJ threatened top AI executive with jail over misconduct
